messages:
Priya Patel: Heads-up everyone — we’re rolling out a short role-based micro-certification called 'Handling Sensitive Deployments' for teams that touch Dedicated / Private deployments and customer data. It’s required for engineers, SREs, and anyone on the onboarding flow for Dedicated capacity. Deadline: 2 weeks from today (final cutover on 2026-04-06).

Alex Chen: ok noted. where do we take it?

Priya Patel: Sign up in the Learning Hub: https://go/redwood/learning/microcert (course + 10-question quiz). Estimated time: ~25 mins. After you pass, upload the certificate to the evidence folder: https://redwood.share/evidence/microcerts and mark yourself on the tracker.

Samira Gomez: Is this additional to the annual privacy module or does it replace anything?

Priya Patel: It’s additive — this micro-cert focuses on operational controls specific to Dedicated/Private (network controls, key handling, data isolation). If you completed 'SOC2 Ops Fundamentals' in the last 12 months, you can skip the quiz but still need to upload proof via this form: https://go/redwood/forms/microcert-exemption.

Ben Rivers: Contractors on infra — do they need to complete?

Priya Patel: Contractors who have access to customer environments must complete it. If you manage contractors, please confirm completion or file an exemption with the contractor name + justification in the form above. Managers will get a reminder digest next week.

Alex Chen: Quick question — does this cover KMS/HSM usage patterns or just network isolation?

Priya Patel: Both. The course has a 6-slide KMS/HSM primer and a short checklist for key rotation and access review. The quiz has 2 questions on key handling.

Samira Gomez: Can we get a CSV export of who’s done it? I want to sync with the rollout team list.

Training Bot: Training Bot: New course "Handling Sensitive Deployments" created. Enrollment open. Use `/training status microcert` to get current completion counts.

Priya Patel: Yes — I’ll export and post a CSV to the #eng-oncall channel by EOD tomorrow. If you’re a manager, watch for the manager digest that lists direct reports missing completion.

Ben Rivers: Will this be enforced for new hires automatically?

Priya Patel: Yes — it will be part of the new-hire checklist for affected roles starting next week. If anyone needs an accommodation or extra time, DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:

Alex Chen: Thanks — doing it after stand.

Training Bot: Training Bot: Alex Chen marked COMPLETE for "Handling Sensitive Deployments" (quiz score 9/10).

Priya Patel: Awesome, thanks Alex. Everyone — please try to finish within the 2-week window so we can close the evidence bundle for the next audit window. Ping me if you hit any access issues.
